purpose: Evaluate semantic candidate selection after the deterministic ACE-S v0.6 evidence pipeline is frozen.

judge.input_rule: The judge receives only task prompt plus authenticated candidate evidence cards generated by the frozen deterministic policy.

output_schema.evidence: array of candidate path and visible line references
output_schema.reason: short semantic justification based only on visible evidence

contamination_guards: Suite B repositories/tasks must be disjoint from deterministic development tasks and Suite A evaluation tasks.
The packet builder must never read the label manifest.
No policy, prompt, threshold, or evidence-card tuning after Suite B judge output is observed.
Any changed judge prompt or deterministic evidence policy requires a fresh Suite B lineage.
claim_boundary: This contract measures blind semantic selection from frozen evidence. It does not repair upstream recall or evidence omissions.
